description: This file defines the SAP AI Core provider class supporting orchestration and foundation models, along with backend classes for handling message creation and prompt completion, integrating with SAP AI SDK and other external modules.

classes.name: SapAiCoreHandler
classes.description: Main provider class supporting SAP AI Core with orchestration and foundation models.

classes.name: SapAiCoreBackend
classes.description: Abstract base class for SAP AI Core backends handling message creation and prompt completion.

classes.name: OrchestrationBackend
classes.description: Backend implementation for SAP AI orchestration mode.

classes.name: FoundationBackend
classes.description: Backend that routes to specific foundation model providers.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Creates a message stream based on system prompt and messages.

methods.name: completePrompt
methods.description: Completes a prompt and returns the generated text.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Retrieves model info, using cache or defaults.

methods.name: createBackend
methods.description: Creates backend instance based on orchestration setting.

methods.name: ensureAiCoreEnvSetup
methods.description: Sets environment variable for AI core service key.

methods.name: createOrchestrationClient
methods.description: Creates an orchestration client with configuration.

methods.name: createProviderBackend
methods.description: Creates backend based on model provider.

methods.name: getModelProvider
methods.description: Determines provider for a given model.

methods.name: createOpenAIClient
methods.description: Creates an Azure OpenAI chat client.

methods.name: convertToFoundationMessages
methods.description: Converts message parameters to foundation model message format.
